label: Tools are here
prompt: A medium photoreal shot of a tropical coastal city rooftop terrace at golden hour. An original techno wizard in an unmarked sun-washed teal technical running coat with faint circuit-thread seams stands at the glass, warm gold-cyan holographic glyph rings hovering over a compact unmarked data-staff. The camera holds, then eases in as the wizard turns toward lens, eyes bright, and says, "The tools are already here — we just have to use them well." A warm terrace breeze and palm rustle sit under distant bay traffic; the voice is close and clear, then a single glyph chime. Unmarked surfaces, empty of lettering. No music and no score. Five seconds.
